main_body: prehistoric palm/cycad tree with canopy and trunk
top_band: light green crown bud/top fronds on rows 1-14
evidence: The tree shows a rounded top crown/canopy from above (rows 1-14) overhanging the lower hanging fronds and cylindrical trunk (rows 15-54) with an eave shadow where the trunk emerges from under the fronds.

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, organically clustered Beodeul reference trees, the candidate has a heavy near-black outline around both the central bud and the outer silhouette, very repetitive 3-px banded patterning down the perfectly straight trunk, and much simpler, blocky frond shapes.
